caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet as the main subject, predominantly colored with alternating dark red and black stripes. The bonnet features gathered fabric that creates a series of rounded, puffed sections and is trimmed at the front with an elaborate, pale lace edge. At the back, the bonnet is gathered with a bow made from the same striped fabric. To the right and slightly below the main image, there is a smaller, monochromatic sketch of the same bonnet design, illustrating its structure and details in shades of gray. The background is a plain, light beige color without additional objects or decoration.
title: Bonnet
